method.strict_limit_definition: Convergence to a finite real a requires: for every epsilon>0 there exists a positive-integer N such that every positive-integer n>N satisfies |x_n-a|<epsilon.
method.no_finite_limit_quantifiers: To exclude every finite limit: for every real a there exists epsilon>0 such that for every positive-integer N there exists a positive-integer n>N with |x_n-a|>=epsilon. Equality is sufficient to defeat the required strict bound.
